checks/independent/fq-gap-born-uniquenes.role: Owned canonical integer-ray value and bounded rational-ray frame-obstruction verification application
checks/independent/fq-gap-born-uniquenes.cost: Each input vector has exactly3 integers with at most4096 bits. Normalize by gcd and leading sign only after whole input admission. Dot has3 products/prefixes; cross6 products/3 differences, each4096-bit admitted. Raw integer products<=8192 bits and addition/subtraction<=4097 before admission. Box radius1..6 preflights before enumeration:at most2197 raw vectors and865 distinct canonical rays;373680 pair candidates at radius6, each constant-sized dot/cross/value work. O(R^2) time/O(R) carrier storage withR<=865. Mod4 key check enumerates64 tuples,32 compatible. Seven-ray basis uses shared6x6 inverse and matrix operations. Default20872 conditions=3*5502 completed pairs+5*865 values/scalings+33 congruence/census+8 obstruction checks.

groups.requirement: Admit exact non-bool integer3-vectors and4096-bit inputs before gcd or arithmetic. Bound every dot product/prefix and cross product/difference. Pair-sign API admits two odd integers and compares their mod4 residues without unnecessarily growing a difference. Public raw-value/box/verification operations use Outcome.

IntegerRay3 owns a nonzero primitive integer representative, gcd1 and first nonzero entry positive. Thus equality/hash identify rational rays represented by integer vectors. Exotic value selects the two odd coordinates only and applies the stated modulo-four sign; other patterns give1/3. Accept nonzero even representatives by normalization, not by extending the old raw parity formula to even vectors. Scaling requires nonzero exact integer, bounds products before normalization, and returns the same canonical ray; no rational-valued input carrier is silently admitted.

Dot uses the canonical integer representatives. Frame completion requires two owned orthogonal rays and normalizes their cross product. The completing ray may leave the enumeration box. Quadratic rows contain a^2,b^2,c^2,2ab,2ac,2bc and exotic(v)*norm-square; squares, doubled cross terms and norm prefixes are checked before export.

Preflight radius1..6, enumerate all nonzero integer vectors, canonicalize/deduplicate and sort. For every distinct orthogonal pair check both completion dot products and exotic sum1. This covers ray pairs represented in the box, not a literal enumeration of all ordered triples in the box. Check every canonical ray value, negation and three original odd scalings.

Replace repeated bounded integer samples by all64 parity-admitted modulo-four tuples, enforcing the32 compatible tuple census. Compose a certified6x6 inverse to fit the first six quadratic equations, show the seventh contradiction, and independently verify a left-null witness with residual-2. Include explicit0,1/3,2/3 witnesses. Require a per-run recorder before work and emit precise counts with a nonzero failure exit.
